lessons: TOP CARRY, do this first next cycle: the ENGLISH description still says the skill will 'geocode' Israeli addresses. It cannot, agent-side: GovMap is a browser-only SDK with a domain-bound API key, which this cycle established and wrote into the body. The Hebrew description was rewritten and no longer implies it, so the over-promise is now English-only and the two languages disagree about capability. It was deliberately NOT fixed in this cycle because the Phase 5.7 gate had already accepted the description as scored, and editing a trigger surface after the gate accepted it defeats the gate. Fix it at the START of the next cycle so it goes through the gate properly.

The evidence gate extracts ZERO numeric facts from this skill, because settlement codes are bare integers in table cells and match none of the currency, percentage or threshold patterns. The gate returned exit 0 for cycles while three wrong settlement codes were live. A green gate here says nothing about the codes. Enumerate them against the full 1,310-record list by hand every cycle. This is the same class of blind spot as the date/time skills the gate could not read.

Spot-checking is what let the three wrong codes through. The v1.3.0 cycle checked 12 of 30 rows, reported them all correct, and the three wrong ones were outside the sample. In this domain a wrong code is a REAL code belonging to a different settlement (3730 is Givat Zeev, 4100 is Katzrin, 7500 is Sakhnin), so the skill answers confidently rather than erroring, and no downstream check can catch it.

The old-value propagation sweep was skipped in this cycle and the Judge caught the consequence: the superseded mikud 6688312 survived in references/city-codes.md dressed as a format example, after being corrected in both SKILL files and in evidence.json. Run the sweep for every changed figure BEFORE the Judge, not after.

Running the bundled script was worth more than reading it. Two of the four Expert CRITICALs were only visible from actual output: apartment tokens being swallowed into the street name, and a fabricated street name for moshav addresses. Both had been in the file across several cycles that read it and passed it.

A previous cycle ADDED a wrong claim while fixing others: v1.3.0 introduced api.govmap.gov.il as 'the canonical endpoint for address autocomplete' requiring only 'email registration'. It is a documentation site for a browser-only SDK whose key is bound to an approved domain. An update that adds an external-dependency claim must probe that dependency, not just cite it.

Carry forward, MAJOR deferred: East Jerusalem and Area C addressing. Neighbourhoods such as שועפאט and בית חנינא are not separate localities and fold into semel 3000, and much of the area has no formally named-and-numbered streets, so the street-plus-number flow fails there for the same structural reason as a non-divided locality. The current one-line 'politically sensitive' gotcha tells the agent nothing about what to output.

Carry forward, MAJOR deferred: merged and renamed localities, and whether retired semel values persist on historical documents. Note that querying the settlements dataset for 'מודיעין' returns nothing for the city; only 'מכבים' returns 1200 מודיעין-מכבים-רעות. A user reading a code off an old form and an agent reading the current list will disagree, and the skill has no reconciliation step.

Carry forward, MAJOR deferred: multi-entrance buildings. The entrance field is now parsed, but there is still no note that apartment numbering restarts per entrance and that dropping the entrance yields an address both a courier and a registry accept and neither can deliver to.

Carry forward, MINOR: SKILL.md's inline 'Major City Codes Reference' duplicates the first ten rows of references/city-codes.md. Two copies of a table whose failure mode is a silently wrong integer is how the next wrong code gets in. Consider collapsing to a pointer.

Telephone area codes in the city tables were NOT verified this cycle and are now labelled orientation-only in the reference file and in the script's output. Source them against the Ministry of Communications numbering plan or drop the column.

Eval-set power was weak: two of the three holdout cases were English queries scored against an unchanged English description, so they could not move. All measured gain sat in the training split (the new Hebrew description fixed a live false-trigger on 'the address of the Israeli embassy in Berlin' and a miss on the kibbutz no-street case). Next cycle use a Hebrew-heavy holdout.
